name: Adrenaline
effect: Melee attacks restore a small amount of HP depending on attack damage for 5 sec after dodging an attack at the last moment.

name: Frenzy
effect: Melee attacks restore a small amount of HP depending on attack damage as long as you have an active speed buff.

name: Initiative
effect: Your first melee strike against an enemy inflicts +[100 base] damage.

name: Killer Instinct
effect: Reduces the cooldown of your skills by [0.4 base, 3 max] seconds for each enemy killed in hand to hand combat.

name: Melee
effect: Melee attacks slow down enemies for [0.2 base, 0.8 max] seconds.

name: Open Wounds
effect: Melee attacks inflict bleeding ([18 base] DPS for 1.5 seconds)

name: Porcupack
effect: Rolling through enemies attacks them with the melee weapon in backpack for [75% base] of the usual damages.

name: Predator
effect: Killing an enemy with a melee strike makes you invisible for [1 base, 3.5 max] seconds.

name: Scheme
effect: Your next melee attack after using a skill inflicts +[200 base] damage.

name: Tainted Flask
effect: Using a health flask adds +[20% base] damage to your attacks for 12 sec. If no flasks are left, killing 12 elite enemies will refill one flask.

name: Vengeance
effect: +[60% base] damage dealt for 8 seconds and -30% damage taken for 3 seconds after taking damage.

name: Acrobatipack
effect: Attacking with a ranged weapon, after rolling with a ranged weapon in your backpack fires a projectile of said weapon, dealing [25% base] of the usual damages.

name: Barbed Tips
effect: Inflicts [40 base] dps per arrow stuck to enemies.

name: Crow's Foot
effect: Rolling leaves 3 crow's feet behind you (with a maximum of 9), inflicting [50 base] damage and slowing the enemies for 1.5 seconds.

name: Hunter's Instinct
effect: Decreases skill cooldowns by [0.3 base, 2.5 max] seconds for each enemy killed with using ranged attacks.

name: Networking
effect: Enemies with arrows stuck in them share [35% base, 75% max] of the damage they receive.

name: Parting Gift
effect: Causes a bomb ([75 base] damage) to appear when you kill an enemy with a non-melee attack.

name: Point Blank
effect: Close-ranged ranged attacks inflicts [30 base]% bonus damage.

name: Ranger's Gear
effect: Your next ranged attack after using a skill inflicts [180 base] damage.

name: Ripper
effect: Hand to hand attacks cause 6 arrows stuck in the attacked enemy to fall out, each one dealing [118 base] damage.

name: Support
effect: +[10% base] damage if you're close to a deployed skill.

name: Tactical Retreat
effect: Dodging an attack at the last moment slows down nearby enemies for [1 base, 3 max] seconds.

name: Tranquility
effect: +[25% base] damage if there are no enemies near you.

name: Armadillopack
effect: Rolling also parries attack and projectiles with the shield in your backpack, for [50% base] of the usual damages.

name: Berserker
effect: Killing an enemy with a melee attack reduces the damage you take by [10% base, 60% max] for 5 sec. Can stack up to 90%. Also makes you immune to stuns.

name: Blind Faith
effect: Reduces the cooldown on your skills by [2.8 base, 6 max] seconds with each successful parry.

name: Counterattack
effect: The attack following a successful parry inflicts +[210 base] damage.

name: Extended Healing
effect: Your health flask heals 85%, its effect is spread over 10 seconds and you deal +[25% base] damage during this time.

name: Gastronomy
effect: The effect of food increases by +65%. If you recycle food you deal +[10% base] damage for 300 seconds.

name: Heart of Ice
effect: Attacking a slowed, stunned, frozen, or rooted enemy at close range reduces skill cooldowns by [0.6 base, 2 max] seconds. Works with both melee and ranged weapons.

name: Kill Rhythm
effect: Alternate weapons to increase your attack speed by [15% base] in 2 seconds.

name: Necromancy
effect: Recover [0.3% base, 2.5% max] HP after killing an enemy, up to a maximum of 50% HP.

name: Soldier's Resistance
effect: Increases your health by [7% base. 40% max].

name: Spite
effect: Successful parries and reflected shots inflict [140 base] damage.

name: What Doesn't Kill Me
effect: Recover [2% base, 6% max] HP after parrying a melee attack.

name: Acceptance
effect: Amount of kills required to remove a curse is reduced by 50%, but consuming food curses you.

name: Alienation
effect: Reducing a curse restores 5% HP but increases the number of enemies required to lift the curse by 50%.

name: Ammo
effect: Ammo for your weapons is now 2 times what it was.

name: Combo
effect: Each consecutive hit that connects continues your combo, increasing your damage dealt.

name: Dead Inside
effect: HP is increased by 50%, but the efficiency of all sources of healing (food, mutations or health potions) is cut in half.

name: Disengagement
effect: Once per biome, if your HP falls below 15%, a force field protects you for 5 sec.

name: Emergency Triage
effect: Health potions only restore 35% HP but their use speed is increased by 275% and it completely protects you for 1.5 sec.

name: Frostbite
effect: Enemies suffer [30 base] DPS while they are slowed down.

name: Get Rich Quick
effect: Accumulate bonus gold for every enemy killed while you have an active speed boost and cash it in when it ends.

name: Gold Plating
effect: Lose gold instead of health when hit. The gold lost is proportional to the health loss prevented.

name: Instinct of the Master of Arms
effect: Reduces the cooldown on your skills by [0.08 base, 1 max] sec with each critical hit.

name: Masochist
effect: Trap damage is capped at 10% of your max HP. When hit by a trap your movement speed increases by 20% for 20 sec.

name: Midas' Blood
effect: Gain 3 gold per health points you lose.

name: No Mercy
effect: Execute mobs under 15% health. Effect halved on bosses.

name: Recovery
effect: Time available to recover your health after a hit is multiplied by 3.

name: Velocity
effect: Running speed duration bonus (for kill combo) multiplied by 3.

name: Wish
effect: Turns the next item picked legendary. Cannot be removed once activated. Cannot be removed. Let's hope it was worth it.

name: Ygdar Orus Li Ox
effect: Saves you ONE TIME if you die prematurely while not cursed. Cannot be picked up after first mutation selection. Cannot be dropped once picked up, even if used.
